context:
Goal: a fix check is as strong a read as the review round it may turn into.
Problem (money): a failed fix check counts as the next round (item 347 a), and rounds 2 and 3 run Sonnet. Yet on non-guard PRs the fix check itself runs Haiku.
Based on (ruling): item 351 a (2026-11-07 14:44 CST): fix checks on guard and check PRs run Sonnet. You are asked again because widening it to every PR is a variant of that ruling.
Based on (ruling): item 347 a (2026-11-07 13:12 CST): a failed fix check counts as the next round.
Based on (measured): four lanes labelled a Sonnet fix check "Round 3 of 3" to pass the spawn guard (#1458, #1774, #2257, #2196).
Departs from: main runs fix checks on non-guard PRs on Haiku — (a) runs every fix check on Sonnet, and the spawn guard gets an exact label for a fix check.
Meanwhile: the lane builds the exact label, and guard PRs keep Sonnet fix checks under 351 a.

options.gain: One rule for all PRs, and a fix check that fails counts as a round read at round strength.
options.label: Every fix check runs on Sonnet
options.lose: About one Sonnet call per small fix.

options.label: Keep Haiku on non-guard PRs, and add only the exact label
options.lose: A Haiku fail can still count as round 2.

reply: You picked a at 15:04 CST Nov 8: every fix check runs on Sonnet. Routed 15:05 CST to the coordinator and lane guard-fix-check-sonnet (session_013NEJKz9HoqeRzdjbw9Fnga). It stays open until that lane reports done, so the lane's grant check counts your answer.
short: Fix checks: Sonnet on every PR?
title: Which model runs a fix check on a PR that is not a guard or check PR?
